abstract: To confirm complete removal of trophoblastic tissues, hysteroscopy was performed in 21 patients after evacuation of hydatidiform mole with an interval of a week. In 15 of these cases, hysteroscopy employed within a week after evacuation of the mole revealed a residue of mole or necrotic decidua. Although complete removal was confirmed in 14 cases on the second hysteroscopy, re-curettage was necessary in 6 patients because necrotic tissues were still found in the uterine cavity. Possible diagnosis of invasive mole was made in 2 cases within 2 weeks after evacuation of the mole by hysteroscopic findings. Hysteroscopy was also performed in 27 patients who were suspected of having a trophoblastic disease from the clinical signs and urinary hCG titer. Hysteroscopic findings which suggested trophoblastic diseases were summarized in the following four categories; 1) the existence of vesicles, 2) buldging or 3) recess of the uterine wall with bleeding or dilated blood vessels and 4) hematoma of the uterine wall. In 9 of the 21 cases with choriocarcinoma, invasive mole or persistent trophoblastic disease, one or two of the above mentioned findings were noted. Moreover, it was possible to differentiate syncytial endometritis from trophoblastic disease from the hysteroscopic findings. Therefore, hysteroscopy seems to be a useful aid not only in confirming complete evacuation of hydatidiform mole but also in the diagnosis and management of malignant sequela.
abstract_ja: 絨毛組織の完全除去を確認するため、胞状奇胎除去術後1週間の間隔で21例に子宮鏡検査を施行した。このうち15例では、除去後1週間以内の子宮鏡検査で奇胎の遺残または壊死した脱落膜が認められた。2回目の子宮鏡検査で14例は完全除去が確認されたが、子宮腔内に壊死組織が残存していた6例では再搔爬が必要であった。子宮鏡所見から、除去後2週間以内に侵入奇胎と診断し得た症例が2例あった。また、臨床所見と尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値から絨毛性疾患が疑われた27例にも子宮鏡検査を行った。絨毛性疾患を示唆する子宮鏡所見は次の4つに分類された：1) 小胞の存在、2) 子宮壁の隆起、3) 出血を伴う陥凹や拡張した血管、4) 子宮壁の血腫。絨毛癌、侵入奇胎または持続性絨毛性疾患の21例中9例では、上記所見のうち1つまたは2つが認められた。さらに、子宮鏡所見により合胞体性子宮内膜炎と絨毛性疾患を鑑別することが可能であった。したがって子宮鏡検査は、胞状奇胎の完全除去の確認だけでなく、悪性続発症の診断と管理にも有用な補助手段と考えられる。
